title: Goals Perimeter Chart
description: Agents Management goals perimeter (AM-2), after the Agent operations design. The live goals are clouds of their agents — one point an agent: white at work, grey idle, a purple ring awaiting, an orange dot blocked, a red cross failed, a yellow triangle degraded — drawn in WebGL with smoke, glass and bloom (a plain canvas where WebGL 2 is missing), under hairline instruments: each goal's progress ring on a tick scale, an orbit of the resource groups it draws on (a diamond empty when traffic flows, dotted when slowed, solid in the held agents' colour with their count, e.g. TOOL 27), lines joining goals that share a group (in a held colour where the same trouble holds both ends; payload links are drawn instead when given), and a callout with the goal's code, status and name, plus AGENTS / PROGRESS / BURN / HELD when the board is drawn at 90% of its design size or more. The board is one orbit camera: drag to turn it, shift-drag to pan, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset; a legend button sits at the bottom left, and the line under the title reads goals, agents and held. It fills the card and follows the page's light or dark theme: by day the picture is laid down in ink on a pale room. Its colours follow the page style like every other chart: SequentialColors1 lights the scene (glow, glass, healthy agents, hairlines, floor) and the secondary colour carries the traffic; held states keep the design system's dataViz hues. Every mark and control explains itself in a tip that follows the pointer; clicking a goal does nothing — it is a standalone chart. Not a free-form node–link graph (that is network-graph) and not a KPI row. D3 and WebGL, no Redux.

goal.description: One shared goal: an object, or only its name.

goals.description: Several goals on one board. Takes precedence over goal.

agents.description: Agent nodes. Alias: nodes. Each names its goal; one that names none joins the first goal, and a goal only agents name is added. Counts per state come from the nodes unless the goal gives them.

links.description: Relationships. Each end is a goal, a resource group or an agent, by id or name; an end that is none of those is an external dependency. Alias: connections.

exceptionCount.description: Agents needing attention across the board, shown in the shell. Defaults to the sum of the goals' exception counts.

thresholds.description: Health below degraded turns the perimeter amber, below critical rose.

show-legend.description: Shows the legend button beside the camera controls.

agent.description: id falls back to name, then label, then its index; state falls back to status.

state.description: Missing reads as healthy; an unknown word as idle. waiting/holding/pending read as awaiting, held as blocked, over budget as degraded. Alias: status.

reason.description: Why it failed or what blocks it, in plain operational language.

blocker.description: Blocked agents only; policy/guardrail read as rule, upstream/resource as dependency, approval/person/manual as human.

code.description: Short reference shown above the name, e.g. G-014.

agents.description: Agent total, or the count per state. Without it the agent nodes are counted.

health.description: 0.88, 88 or "88%". Shown as PROGRESS; the progress arc runs clockwise from 12 o'clock for this share. Omitted, the healthy share of agents.

multiplier.description: Ratio against the goal's baseline, shown as BURN (1.1×). A goal that burns hotter turns its cloud a little faster.

exceptionCount.description: Agents needing attention, shown as HELD. Defaults to degraded + awaiting + blocked + failed. Alias: impure.

status.description: Status override. Otherwise from health and thresholds: healthy is ON TRACK, degraded AT RISK, critical OFF TRACK; blocked reads as critical and is labelled BLOCKED.

statusLabel.description: Words beside the status dot; shown uppercase. Defaults to ON TRACK, AT RISK or OFF TRACK, or BLOCKED for status blocked.

exceptions.description: Agents per held state with the reason. Without it the agent nodes are grouped by state and reason.

items.description: Entries without a readable state or count are skipped.

blocker.description: Blocked only; same aliases as agent blocker.

resourceGroups.description: The groups on the goal's orbit, or only how many there are. A group with the same name on several goals is the same group: when no links are given, a line joins the goals that share it (a group every goal uses is left unjoined).

name.description: Printed on the orbit, uppercase; also how the same group is recognised on other goals. Alias: label.

kind.description: model, toolset, infrastructure, pipeline, data, sensor, policy, alert…; picks the glyph. Alias: type.

state.description: How the goal fares with the group: its traffic flows (healthy), some is slowed (degraded), or agents are held there (awaiting, blocked, failed). Alias: status.

agents.description: Agents that depend on this group.

held.description: Agents of the goal held on this group, printed after its name (TOOL 27). A count with no state reads as blocked.

calls.description: Calls a minute the goal makes to it: more calls, more sparks to its diamond and more light on its links. Default 1000.

position.description: Board position, x and y 0–1 (clamped) across a 1280 × 620 design space, with an optional depth z (a share of the width, −1–1, further away when positive) and radius r (a share of the width; default sized by agents). An [x, y] pair, an {x, y, z, r} object, or x / y on the goal itself. Applies only when every goal has one; otherwise goals are laid out automatically.

x.description: Board position x when position is not given.

y.description: Board position y when position is not given.

link.description: source / target, or their aliases from / to; a link naming neither end is dropped. A goal-to-goal link runs through a resource group the two goals share, when they share one.

strands.description: Folded links between the same two goals. Aliases: weight, value.

status.description: down/broken/failed/offline… read as unavailable; warning/slow/partial… as degraded.
